text: A crow can make a decision faster than you can blink.
And it's about twice as fast as you.
Scientists gave two crows a touchscreen full of moving dots.
Their job? Spot which way most dots were moving, and peck that side.
The crows did it in about a quarter of a second.
In tasks like this, people usually take about twice as long.
But here's the wild part. Their brain cells picked the answer just seventy milliseconds in.
And crows don't even have the brain layer we use for this.
It was only two crows, so it still needs more tests.
But next time a crow stares at you... it already decided.
